findings.rationale: The range report shows aws_security_group sg-admin permitting 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on tcp/22, making the administrative service reachable without network restriction.
The range report identifies aws_security_group sg-db allowing 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on tcp/3306, leaving the database service broadly reachable.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The range report shows the trap bucket’s anonymous s3:GetObject grant, while aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block trap keeps it blocked rather than exploitable.
